units.rawText: The cardinal rule of the food service industry is as such: a clumsy waiter won't get any tips!

units.rawText: Without tips, your salary isn't enough to buy the things you want.

units.rawText: Therefore, if you want to earn money you will have to look competent, and never embarrass yourself in front of customers!
